notes: Washington's capital gains excise tax (RCW 82.87) applies to long-term capital gains above a standard deduction and exempts assets held in retirement accounts (RCW 82.87.050(3)), so it does not reach retirement income. Enacted change for later years: per the Department of Revenue, the 2026 Legislature (Senate Bill 6346) created a 9.9% income tax on individuals and joint filers with annual adjusted gross income over $1 million, effective January 1, 2028 (first returns due April 2029); how it will treat retirement income is not covered here.
